sync_policy: CatalogCreateCollection frames are flushed before catalog root visibility; the system root and AppliedCommandLSN are published in the same backend finalize boundary.

matrix_status_changes.collection_index_create_drop: WAL-rejected pre-frame until index catalog command support lands

crash_scenarios: unapplied CatalogCreateCollection frame replays after reopen and advances AppliedCommandLSN
same-metadata CatalogCreateCollection replay is idempotent and still advances the covered replay LSN
incompatible CatalogCreateCollection replay fails closed before publishing AppliedCommandLSN or replacing the existing catalog metadata
a recovered lower command LSN is applied before a public catalog create receives the next contiguous command LSN
runtime_assertions: CatalogCreateCollection payload collection name must match decoded collection metadata name
public CreateCollection rechecks existing catalog metadata immediately before system-root publication
rejected index DDL returns ErrCommandWALUnsupported before frame append or AppliedCommandLSN movement

performance_gate.rationale: The catalog-create throughput lane is a required command-WAL performance gate and must be strictly greater than 1.01x of the WAL-off baseline. The recorded artifact passes that bar; rejected index DDL is reported as unsupported-path cost evidence rather than a comparative throughput gate.

unsupported_modes: CreateIndex remains WAL-rejected in command_wal_v1 mode
DropIndex remains WAL-rejected in command_wal_v1 mode
DropIndexes remains WAL-rejected in command_wal_v1 mode
DropAllIndexes remains WAL-rejected in command_wal_v1 mode
query-wide collection mutations remain outside PR6

cleanup_debt.notes: PR6 catalog create payload embeds canonical collection metadata and introduces no external refs.
